description: Megumi's regular date conversations: all of SERIFU/DATE_MI.BIN (girl 9, load address 0x80198000; section/place map in game-internals 6k, `tools/date_sections.py --girl 9`), 475 strings including the ones the dumper misses; pure-punctuation pause lines stay in Japanese. Section 16 (Ski Resort) is a null entry in her fill function: she has no ski date. Same 27-section layout as Shiori's and Yuko's files. Options and thought endings are even-length; with an odd-length name nothing follows {G} on its line (an option ending on the name shows a space before the bracket, accepted). Identical lines share one copy. Verified in DuckStation on forced dates (date_run.ps1 -Girl 9 -Version -1, hidden; docs/testing.md 'The other girls' dates'): meeting on time, the neighborhood park, Aquarium, Planetarium, Arcade, Theme Park (first rides), Concert Hall and Shrine, each with its first choice, her reply and verdict, the player's answer and the way home. Checked only statically: other versions, later choices, moods, being late, natural triggers. Her date events are in megumi_events.json; the impression thoughts in date_shared.json.
